## 3800 - 3899

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03800">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3800 GQA - Low 3,4-dimethylhexane</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03800">

Found as part of the Extended Analysis, this exception is generated when a source’s 3,4-Dimethylhexane mole % value exceeds the user defined limit for minimum value for 3,4-Dimethylhexane mole %. For example, the minimum limit for 3,4-Dimethylhexane mole % is set to 0.1000, but the 3,4-Dimethylhexane mole % on the sample is imported at 0.0999.

</div>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03887">

Found as part of the Extended Analysis, this exception is generated when a source’s 3,3-Dimethylheptane mole % value exceeds the user defined limit for maximum value for 3,3-Dimethylheptane mole %. For example, the maximum limit for 3,3-Dimethylheptane mole % is set to 0.5000, but the 3,3-Dimethylheptane mole % on the sample is imported at 0.5001.

</div>
